about: The vocabulary in which every place socket is written (0103 decision 5). compile_settlement refuses a socket kind, activity, day phase, schedule purpose, item class, container class or fill rule that is not listed here. Each item class names the vanilla mesh folder or file that supplies its meshes. A socket therefore cannot promise an item that has no asset.
itemKindsAbout: Each item class lists the kinds an item socket names in itemKind (16k walk 12: the item system must know a mace is a mace), each with the vanilla mesh that shows it. A kind no mesh shows is never added; a stack is one socket over several placements of the kind's mesh.

tool.assetSource: vanilla:meshes/clutter/common (hoe, pickaxe01, saw01, shovel01, pitchfork01) and clutter/blacksmith

kinds.iron-ingot-stack: vanilla:meshes/dungeons/mines/ore/ingotiron01.nif (vanilla has no stack mesh: one socket over several stacked ingot placements)

hidden-cache.about: A cache hidden where reaching it takes effort (2.3 c, world/20 §12.3b). Never derived from a model name: authored on a socket with `reach` and `effort`; effort 3 or more takes an authored lootTable (worldgen.exploration_rewards).

fillRulesAbout: A container socket's `fillRule` is a blanket rule id of the loot-rules table (worldgen.sockets.load_vocabulary reads its ids) or `authored`. A blanket socket's list is frozen at authoring time by `python3 -m worldgen.loot_fill --place <id> --apply` into `lootTable {items, frozenFrom}`; an authored socket's `lootTable` carries `storyNote` and, once 2.3c fills it, `items` (00-core rule 9: nothing rolls at play time).

plantClasses._: The harvestable plant socket (2.3a, decision 6): an already-placed flora piece of one of these species is a one-slot container holding its linked ingredient, which regrows `regrowDays` in-game days after harvest. No new plant models, no new placement.

mountain-flower.note: 2.9b-e: red first, the node piece; the blue cluster reads as a grey bush at a place's distance.

rootland-mushroom.note: 2.9b-e: tall stems are the lore's rootland mushroom (ecology-encounters-loot.md:36); no exterior kit carries a small mushroom with the runtime's three LOD tiers (floramushroom02/05 are interior-kit rows with one).

dragons-tongue.note: 2.9b-e: the source game's dragon's tongue flora (Skyrim.esm FLOR DragonsTongue gives INGR DragonsTongue); the Murkmire kit places it in Argonian ground.

pearl-clam.note: 2.3c: a placed clam of the coast holds one pearl; a new one grows in a month (the Oliis pearl lots; item.oliis-pearl's sources).

somnalius-fern.note: 2.3c2: the placed ferns are the somnalius fern of the marsh (fauna-hazards.md:98); a frond grows back in three days.

marshweed.note: 2.9b-e: marshweed is a reed tuft at the water's edge (fauna-hazards.md:99), smoked by the marsh folk; 2.4 m high, seated on its base (designed sink 0, four LOD tiers). The old species, algrass03b, read as agave and sank its stalks; the groundcover tufts carry two LOD tiers, not the runtime's three. 2.9b-p: the medium reed (four LOD tiers) already placed at the water's edge is the same tuft grown taller.

nirnroot.note: 2.9b-p: nirnroot grows in Black Marsh (fauna-hazards.md:101), a very rare plant that grows near water (UESP Lore:Nirnroot, citing The Improved Emperor's Guide to Tamriel: Black Marsh); the source game's flora mesh, three LOD tiers (interior-farmhouse-v1), 0.76 m. Rare, so it is placed one to a place by water and regrows slowly.

commonFields.valueTier: required on container, item and plant sockets: one of valueBands (2.3c fills every socket; null only until then)
commonFields.lock: container sockets and doors: a lock id of world/sources/registries/locks.json, or null
commonFields.item: item sockets: the item record id (item.<slug>) the socket places
commonFields.regrowDays: plant sockets only: in-game days before the ingredient is back (defaults to the class's)

forge.dressingNote: the anvil set beside a forge (2.9b-e): settled furniture-like dressing a layer publish admits

alchemy.note: the alchemy apparatus table (2.9b-e; register row source.vanilla-crafting-stations)

enchanting.note: the enchanting table (2.9b-e): the shrine's station shelf

smelter.note: the bloomery's smelter: a work-at spot hosted on it is a metal-mending station (2.4i)

shrine.note: an altar or offering stone a pilgrim prays at (2.4i); the station socket names its host; this kit piece is the slice shrine's offering block

interactables.about: 2.4i: what a player does at a socket. Counted classes: sign (read), sleep (idle sleep), sit (idle sit), cook (idle cook, a work-at spot on a cooking host, a cooking-spit station), station (a station socket, or a work-at spot on a stationHosts host), shrine (a station socket of class shrine; pray). game-core interaction/interactables.ts holds these tables equal; worldgen.interactables gates every slice socket of these classes bound.
interactables.repairsAbout: metal: weapons and armour of any set but softSets; soft: clothing and armour of softSets; none: the station reads as a sign of the trade
interactables.prayerText: text.shrine.<socket id past socket.>: the words a prayer shows

serviceSurfaces.about: Decision 0113: a work socket (a station, or an idle socket whose activity is work-at) hosted on one of these is served across the host (its interact point is kind customer); any other work socket is used where the worker stands (kind station). Matched on the host asset's file name, as furnitureActivities is.

sign.pointsTo: one route., track. or place. id per arm (a waymark)
sign.textKey: a row of world/sources/placement/sign-text.json: the sign's words, in the text catalogue

waymark.about: a road or track sign: one arm per route., track. or place. id; the arms read their names, so it needs no textKey

place-name.about: names the place at its edge or gate

service.about: hangs at a service's door or stall and names the trade (smith, trader, inn)

warning.about: warns of a danger: a predator in the water, bad ground, a closed way

pilgrim-notice.about: a carved stone or board at a shrine telling a visitor what is done there

doorTypes.load: a cell transition: the door-links record holds an XTEL for its shell (worldgen.door_types)
doorTypes.swing: opens in place by animation; no cell
